findings.claim: Exporting `HTTPBatchStreamLinkOptions` widens the public API surface; verify it is actually re-exported from the package entrypoint and does not collide with an existing exported name.
findings.rationale: The change itself is type-only and cannot alter runtime behavior. Two things worth a second look, though I cannot confirm either from this hunk alone: (1) if the module's symbols are re-exported via a barrel (`export * from './links/httpBatchStreamLink'`), a name clash with a similarly named type from `httpBatchLink`/`unstable_httpBatchStreamLink` would cause a TS ambiguity/duplicate-export error; (2) if the barrel only re-exports an explicit list, adding `export` here has no effect for consumers and the type still won't be importable from the package root. Low confidence — both are just verification items.
